description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Wind 3 with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Nine] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Nine
description.text: Increases [Wind Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Nine after using a Wind ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Whirling Lance+
description.text: Six single ranged jump attacks (1.20/1.25 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Nine
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Imperil Prismatic 30% (15s)] to the target and grants [Deadly Strikes +10% 2] to the user/party with at least 0-3/4+ Dragoon members in the party

description.name: Attach Wind 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
